verdict.rationale: LanceDB's versioning docs cover version control and data snapshots, and time-travel lets you access earlier table states. Branching forks isolated lines of table history. Together these give built-in snapshot points, but the pack never documents an explicit restore operation or a backup copied off the primary store. Missing for 10: explicit restore/rollback documentation, backup to a separate location or disaster-recovery workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
